title: Mamdani-backed candidates win New York primaries
summary: Three candidates backed by New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani won Democratic primary elections for seats in the US House of Representatives on Tuesday, according to US media projections, an outcome that showcased Mamdani's rising influence on the Democratic party.
